txd.enforcement: A PBC Collection Fleet was destroyed. A stronger one will follow.
txd.refused: Refused a PBC Collection Fleet's demands
msg.sovereignDefault: Sovereign default: %s can no longer service its debt to the Confederation. Government bonds lose value.
report.installments.tooltip: Scheduled payments on your Persean Banking Confederation loans, paid automatically. Toggle autopay in the PBC Banking Terminal (Intel screen).
report.garnishment.tooltip: A share of your colony income seized by the Persean Banking Confederation because a loan is in default. Clear the past-due amount to stop it.
fleet.collection.name: PBC Collection Fleet
notice.phase1.title: PBC Payment Reminder
notice.phase1.desc: A payment of %s credits on your %s is overdue. Pay the past-due amount in the Banking Terminal to avoid penalties.
notice.phase2.title: PBC Collection Warning
notice.phase2.desc: Your %s is %s days overdue. Penalty interest applies and new banking services are suspended.
notice.phase3.title: PBC Enforcement Notice
notice.phase3.desc: The Confederation has dispatched a Collection Fleet over %s credits past due (%s credits outstanding). Settle with them, or face them.
notice.phase4.title: PBC Default Judgment
notice.phase4.desc: Your %s is in default. The bank seizes your investments, and %s%% of your colony income will be garnished every month until the past-due amount is cleared.
notice.howToPay: Open the PBC Banking Terminal (Intel > Economy) to pay the past-due amount.
collection.title: PBC Collection Action
collection.hunting: A Collection Fleet is hunting you.
collection.explain: The Persean Banking Confederation has dispatched an Enforcement Fleet. When it reaches you, its commander will demand payment - you may pay, surrender a ship as collateral, or refuse and fight. Paying the past-due amount in the Banking Terminal recalls the fleet.
collection.warning: Destroying the fleet does not clear the debt; a larger fleet will follow.
dialog.collection.inOrder: "Our records show your account is in order, Captain. The Confederation thanks you for your business."
dialog.collection.hail1: "Captain. This is an enforcement action of the Persean Banking Confederation regarding account %s, your %s."
dialog.collection.figures: Past due: %s. Outstanding balance: %s. Days overdue: %s.
dialog.collection.hail2: "Settle the arrears now and we part as partners. Otherwise we are authorized to take collateral - or to take it by force."
dialog.collection.thanks: "A pleasure doing business. Fly safe, Captain."
dialog.collection.noCollateral: "You have nothing we can accept as collateral."
dialog.collection.seized: A prize crew boards the %s. The Confederation credits %s against your debt.
dialog.collection.partial: Still past due: %s. "This covers part of it. We'll be in touch."
dialog.collection.current: "Your account is current. Good day, Captain."
dialog.collection.refused: "Then the Confederation will recover its assets the hard way."
dialog.collection.repLoss: Relations with the Persean Banking Confederation decreased.
dialog.collection.later: "We'll be watching, Captain. Don't make us come looking."
branch.intro: The Confederation branch office is all brass, marble and quiet keyboards. A teller in a gold-trimmed uniform pulls up your file.
branch.summary: Credit score: %s (%s). Outstanding debt: %s. Past due: %s.
branch.paid: You settle %s in arrears at the counter.
branch.cannotPay: You can't cover any past-due installment right now.
